subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'COURT' is coded as ‘5 - 77’, 'CASE’ is coded as '4 - 28’. How will 'LAWYER' be coded in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Coded word is written as '(No. of letters) - (Sum of the positional values of letters).**

 
• In COURT → 5 - 77

 
 
• ​No. of letters = 5
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e21393873194417e2d5f80a87223583cea9874ab3ddb6a37db990d6d2b684e77.png] 
 
• Sum of positional values = 3 +15 + 21+ 18 + 20 = 77
 
• Coded word = '5 - 77'.
 
 

 

 
• In CASE → 4 - 28 ​

 
 
• ​No. of letters = 4
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aec2d86ec323f12e27cb5119d606e656668747308c5c35a13128b4f65c035922.png] 
 
• Sum of positional values = 3 +1 + 19 + 5 = 28
 
• Coded word = '4 - 28'.
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, in **LAWYER **→** ** ​

 
 
• ​No. of letters = 6
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb461e7b575afd611a9ce8b07d24440cc084921e464b28149e28902feeed82a1.png] 
 
• Sum of positional values = 12 +1 + 23 + 25 + 5 + 18 = 84
 
• Coded word = '6 - 84'.
 
 

Hence, "Option 2)" is the correct answer.
